phases.name: Runaway
phases.say: (Something inside it breaks, and it stops steering.)

say.open: (The engine roars. It has been waiting for a road.)
say.death: (The wheels spin on, slower, and stop.)

bestiary.lore: The card of will and victory: a war machine of the old forge that wants only to go forward, over whatever is there.
bestiary.weakness: Water rusts it. Spread out against the charge.
bestiary.pattern: Every third turn a full charge down the densest row; trampling three rows and scything every Front between. Runaway at half: the charge every other turn, and faster.
